selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F16 semantic-tag table overflow safety closure on the DX11 branch.
summary: F16 replaces destructive semantic-tag saturation with a non-evicting fail-safe policy. When the fixed 0x230 table is full, already-published exact HUD/world ownership remains intact and only the new registration is rejected; if that node is later consumed it follows the existing ScreenOverlay2D fallback. SpriteNodeSemanticOverflowRejected exposes abnormal saturation, and the backend disassembly verifier rejects reintroduction of oldest-live-tag eviction or overflow being misreported as stale cleanup. Capacity, producer ranges, native DX11 activation, D3D9 policy and OpenXR transport are unchanged.

risk_review.reason: Semantic ownership is runtime-visible under abnormal table pressure. The new policy preserves older live exact ownership instead of silently corrupting it, but a newly rejected saturated tag still falls back to generic ScreenOverlay2D. Hosted CI proves source/build/contract integrity only; no Quest3/VDXR visual run was performed.

evidence: The validation-bearing result commit message contains the exact marker [AUTO:CONVERSION-DX11-00112] and contains no CI-skip directive.
RegisterSpriteNodeScope no longer selects or overwrites the oldest live semantic tag when SpriteNodeSemanticCapacity is exhausted.
SpriteNodeSemanticOverflowRejected records rejected saturated registrations without incrementing the stale-cleanup counter.
The rejected new node retains the existing fail-safe ScreenOverlay2D fallback if no exact tag can be consumed.
The backend disassembly verifier rejects restoration of oldest-live-tag eviction and rejects overflow being counted as stale cleanup.
No producer range, semantic table capacity, native draw activation, D3D9 render policy or OpenXR transport behavior was changed.
Backend Conversion Gate, generic Build, HUD Inspector and all six OpenXR architecture jobs pass for the validation-bearing result SHA.
No N100 clone/worktree, PC fast runner, Quest3/VDXR or in-game execution was used.
